name: B · Side-on
premise: Say the name: the flat-back tuck, built from primitives, with one hairline error band and ring wheels instead of solid discs.

items.title: Flat-back, bleed
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-2-2-2-2 = 13/14. Straight-bar back, amber error band, ring wheels bleeding off the bottom; same as 14. Best rider read at 64; S3 capped at 1 (still a cyclist glyph).

items.title: Rounded tuck, bleed
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-2-2-2-1 = 12/14. Same as 02: humped back from 0675 proportions. Warmer, more figure-like; S7 1 because the name says flat-back.

items.title: Hub crop, big rider
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-2-2-1-2 = 12/14. Same as 08: rider fills the field, dim rings bleed left/right/bottom. Survives blur best; side bleed costs S6.

items.title: Tuck, ring wheels
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-1-2-2-2 = 12/14. Whole bike in frame, grey band. Rider is small against grey rings at 64.

items.title: Dark disc wheels
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-1-2-2-2 = 12/14. Wheels as #161616 discs with grey rim, bleeding. Disc answers the solid-disc problem without a bright mass; rims still compete.

items.title: Upright ghost, grey
items.note: S1-S7 1-2-1-1-2-1-2 = 10/14. A/B back angle: hairline upright (0677 construction) behind the tuck. Ghost vanishes at 64; figure is small.

items.title: Upright ghost, amber
items.note: S1-S7 1-2-1-1-2-1-2 = 10/14. As 04 with an amber ghost.

items.title: Hairline wheels
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-1-1-2-2 = 11/14. Wheels as 9-unit rings; vanish under blur. Band device is the wheels, not an outline of the rider.

items.title: Hub crop, helmet tail
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-2-2-1-2 = 12/14. Crop with aero-helmet tail and grey band. Tail makes the head read as a blob.

items.title: Flat-back, whole bike
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-1-2-2-2 = 12/14. Straight-bar back, amber band, full bike. Clean; rider smaller than final-1.

items.title: Dim rings, no band
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-2-0-2-2 = 11/14. Control with no error band: S5 zero. Rider pops against #333 rings.

items.title: Amber rings
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-1-1-2-2 = 11/14. Amber wheels pull the eye off the rider at 64.

items.title: Helmet tail, amber band
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-1-2-2-2 = 12/14. Whole bike, helmet tail, amber band.

items.title: Hub crop, amber band
items.note: S1-S7 2-2-1-2-2-1-2 = 12/14. Crop with rounded back and amber band; legs run off the field.
